mapper.sql: id, reclassification_month, system_code, org_id, contract_code, business_code, contract_status, client_code, client_name, bank_org_id, ebank_serial_number, ebank_batch_no, ebank_client_name, operation_remark, ta_excess_balance, rent_check, ebank_check, ta_reclassification_amount, lease_date_end, receivable_rent_balance, remark, special_contract_status, ta_account_code, ta_account_name, exception_type, process_status, process_instance_id, is_generate_voucher, voucher_id, error_info, account_date, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.select: select enccs.collection_accounts_bank bank_org_id, etrd.id, etrd.reclassification_month, etrd.system_code, etrd.org_id, etrd.contract_code, etrd.business_code, etrd.contract_status, etrd.client_code, etrd.client_name, --etrd.bank_org_id, etrd.ebank_serial_number, etrd.ebank_batch_no, etrd.ebank_client_name, etrd.operation_remark, etrd.ta_excess_balance, etrd.rent_check, etrd.ebank_check, etrd.ta_reclassification_amount, etrd.lease_date_end, etrd.receivable_rent_balance, etrd.remark, etrd.special_contract_status, etrd.ta_account_code, etrd.ta_account_name, etrd.exception_type, etrd.process_status, etrd.process_instance_id, etrd.is_generate_voucher, etrd.voucher_id, etrd.error_info, etrd.account_date, etrd.del_flag, etrd.create_by, etrd.create_time, etrd.update_by, etrd.update_time, etrd.ta_reclassification_id, etrd.account_code from eg_ta_reclassification_detail etrd left join eg_non_confirm_collection_account_checking enccs on enccs.ebank_serial_number like '%'||etrd.ebank_serial_number||'%' and enccs.account_checking_month = substring(#{queryDate},1,7) where etrd.reclassification_month = to_date(#{queryDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') and etrd.system_code = #{systemCode}

with month_data as ( select orgin.id, orgin.reclassification_month, orgin.system_code, orgin.org_id org_id, orgin.contract_code, coalesce(ec.business_code,'ZLYW') business_code, --默认租赁业务 orgin.contract_status, -- etrd.client_code, -- etrd.client_name, case when orgin.system_code in ('XWXT','TYPT') then orgin.client_code when orgin.system_code in ('CYCXT','SYCXT') then ec.client_code else null end client_code, case when orgin.system_code in ('XWXT','TYPT') then orgin.client_name when orgin.system_code in ('CYCXT','SYCXT') then ec.client_name else null end client_name, orgin.bank_org_id, orgin.ebank_serial_number, orgin.ebank_batch_no, orgin.ebank_client_name, orgin.operation_remark, orgin.ta_excess_balance, orgin.rent_check, orgin.ebank_check, orgin.ta_reclassification_amount, ec.lease_date_end lease_date_end, orgin.receivable_rent_balance, orgin.remark, ec.financial_contract_status special_contract_status, orgin.ta_account_code, orgin.ta_account_name, orgin.exception_type, orgin.process_status, orgin.process_instance_id, orgin.is_generate_voucher, orgin.voucher_id, orgin.error_info, orgin.account_date, orgin.del_flag, orgin.create_by, orgin.create_time, orgin.update_by, orgin.update_time, orgin.ta_reclassification_id from eg_ta_reclassification_detail orgin left join eg_contract_month ec on orgin.org_id = ec.org_id and orgin.contract_code = ec.contract_code where orgin.reclassification_month = to_date(#{queryDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ) --select * from eg_contract_balance_latest ecbl where ecbl.org_id='01-C0001' and ecbl.contract_code ='L15A0331003' ,latest_rent as ( select t.contract_code, t.org_id, sum(t.receivable_rent_balance) receivable_rent_balance from (select contract_code, org_id, receivable_rent_amount receivable_rent_balance from eg_contract_balance where period_code = to_char(to_date(#{queryDate}, 'YYYY-MM'), 'YYYYMM')::integer union all select contract_code, org_id, receivable_rent_balance from eg_contract_balance_month where period_code = to_char(to_date(#{queryDate}, 'YYYY-MM')-1, 'YYYYMM')::integer) t where exists (select 1 from month_data where t.org_id = month_data.org_id and t.contract_code = month_data.contract_code) group by t.contract_code, t.org_id ) ,cur_month_claim as ( select sum(claim_amount) as cur_claim_amount, ebank_serial_number from eg_business_claim_repayment_record where del_flag ='0' and to_char(business_date,'yyyy-MM') = substr(#{queryDate},1,7) group by ebank_serial_number ) , non_confirm_num as ( select count(1) num from eg_non_confirm_collection_account_checking where account_checking_month = substr(#{queryDate},1,7) ) ,non_confirm as (
select enccac.ebank_serial_number , case when (select num from non_confirm_num) > 0 then sum(coalesce(enccac.cur_month_balance,0)) when (select num from non_confirm_num) = 0 then sum(coalesce(enccac.cur_month_balance,0) + coalesce(cmc.cur_claim_amount,0)) else 0 end as cur_month_balance -- sum(coalesce(enccac.cur_month_balance,0)+coalesce(enccac2.cur_month_credit_amount,0)) cur_month_balance from eg_non_confirm_collection_account_checking enccac left join cur_month_claim cmc on enccac.ebank_serial_number = cmc.ebank_serial_number where enccac.account_checking_month = (case when (select num from non_confirm_num) > 0 then substr(#{queryDate},1,7) else to_char(#{queryDate}::date - INTERVAL '1 month', 'yyyy-MM') end ) and exists (select 1 from month_data where month_data.ebank_batch_no = enccac.ebank_serial_number) group by enccac.ebank_serial_number ) ,month_data_view as ( select month_data.*, (select sum(ta_excess_balance) from month_data) ta_excess_balance_total, amount_by_contract.total ta_excess_balance_contract, amount_by_batch.total ta_excess_balance_batch, latest_rent.receivable_rent_balance receivable_rent_balance_tmp, non_confirm.cur_month_balance from month_data left join latest_rent on month_data.org_id = latest_rent.org_id and month_data.contract_code = latest_rent.contract_code left join non_confirm on month_data.ebank_batch_no = non_confirm.ebank_serial_number left join (select sum(ta_excess_balance) total,coalesce(month_data.contract_code,'') contract_code from month_data group by coalesce(month_data.contract_code,'')) amount_by_contract on coalesce(month_data.contract_code,'') = coalesce(amount_by_contract.contract_code,'') left join (select sum(ta_excess_balance) total,coalesce(month_data.ebank_batch_no,'') ebank_serial_number from month_data group by coalesce(month_data.ebank_batch_no,'')) amount_by_batch on coalesce(month_data.ebank_batch_no,'') = coalesce(amount_by_batch.ebank_serial_number,'') ) , res as ( select month_data_view.id, month_data_view.reclassification_month, month_data_view.system_code, month_data_view.org_id, month_data_view.contract_code, month_data_view.business_code, month_data_view.contract_status, month_data_view.client_code, month_data_view.client_name, month_data_view.bank_org_id, month_data_view.ebank_serial_number, month_data_view.ebank_batch_no, month_data_view.ebank_client_name, month_data_view.operation_remark, month_data_view.ta_excess_balance, month_data_view.lease_date_end, month_data_view.remark, month_data_view.special_contract_status, month_data_view.process_status, month_data_view.process_instance_id, month_data_view.is_generate_voucher, month_data_view.voucher_id, month_data_view.error_info, month_data_view.account_date, month_data_view.del_flag, month_data_view.create_by, month_data_view.create_time, month_data_view.update_by, month_data_view.update_time, month_data_view.ta_excess_balance_total, month_data_view.ta_excess_balance_contract, month_data_view.ta_excess_balance_batch, month_data_view.receivable_rent_balance_tmp receivable_rent_balance, month_data_view.cur_month_balance,
case when coalesce(special_contract_status,'') in ('资产出表（ABS）','资产处置结束（保理出表）','资产处置结束（第三方转让）') then null when coalesce(special_contract_status,'') not in ('资产出表（ABS）','资产处置结束（保理出表）','资产处置结束（第三方转让）') and coalesce(ta_excess_balance_contract,0) <= coalesce(receivable_rent_balance_tmp,0) then '是' when coalesce(special_contract_status,'') not in ('资产出表（ABS）','资产处置结束（保理出表）','资产处置结束（第三方转让）') and coalesce(ta_excess_balance_contract,0) > coalesce(receivable_rent_balance_tmp,0) then '否' else null end as rent_check, case when coalesce(ta_excess_balance_batch,0) <= coalesce(cur_month_balance,0) then '是' when coalesce(ta_excess_balance_batch,0) > coalesce(cur_month_balance,0) then '否' else null end as ebank_check, case when business_code='ZLYW' and coalesce(special_contract_status,'') in ('资产出表（ABS）','资产处置结束（保理出表）') then '2241.10.01' when business_code='ZLYW' and coalesce(special_contract_status,'') not in ('资产出表（ABS）','资产处置结束（保理出表）','资产处置结束（第三方转让）') then '1531.01.01' when business_code='BLYW' and coalesce(special_contract_status,'') in ('资产出表（ABS）','资产处置结束（保理出表）') then '2241.16' when business_code='BLYW' and coalesce(special_contract_status,'') not in ('资产出表（ABS）','资产处置结束（保理出表）','资产处置结束（第三方转让）') then '1122.03.01' when business_code='ZLYW' and coalesce(special_contract_status,'') in ('资产处置结束（第三方转让）') then '2241.09' when business_code='WDYW' then '1303.01' else null end as ta_account_code from month_data_view ) ,res_all as( select res.*, case when coalesce(rent_check,'') = '是' and coalesce(ebank_check,'') = '是' then ta_excess_balance when rent_check is null and coalesce(ebank_check,'') = '是' then ta_excess_balance else 0 end as ta_reclassification_amount from res ) select distinct res_all.*, case when coalesce(cur_month_balance,0) != 0 and coalesce(receivable_rent_balance,0) != 0 and coalesce(ta_reclassification_amount,0) = 0 then '1'--应收租金和网银余额不为零，但重分类金额为零 else '0' end as exception_type --无异常 from res_all

select null as client_code ,null as client_name ,null as operation_remark ,ebank_batch_no,ebank_serial_number,bank_org_id,ta_excess_balance,contract_code,ebank_client_name,org_id,contract_status,'CYCXT' as system_code from ta_cyc where contract_code is not null and contract_code <> '' union all select null as client_code ,null as client_name ,null as operation_remark ,ebank_batch_no,ebank_serial_number,bank_org_id,ta_excess_balance,contract_code,ebank_client_name,org_id,contract_status,'SYCXT' as system_code from ta_syc where contract_code is not null and contract_code <> '' union all select client_code ,client_name ,operation_remark ,ebank_serial_number as ebank_batch_no,ebank_serial_number,null as bank_org_id,ta_excess_balance,contract_code,ebank_client_name,org_id,contract_status,'TYPT' as system_code from ta_typt where contract_code is not null and contract_code <> '' union all select client_code ,client_name ,operation_remark ,ebank_serial_number as ebank_batch_no,ebank_serial_number,null as bank_org_id,ta_excess_balance,contract_code,ebank_client_name,org_id,contract_status,'YYPT' as system_code from ta_yypt where contract_code is not null and contract_code <> '' union all select client_code ,client_name ,operation_remark ,null as ebank_batch_no,ebank_serial_number,bank_org_id,ta_excess_balance,contract_code,ebank_client_name,org_id,contract_status,'XWXT' as system_code from ta_xw where contract_code is not null and contract_code <> ''
